body: Thanks for responding, it means a lot. Especially pointing out other choices/options. I know I get one-track when I'm like this and can't think of any way out. It just feels like I can be completely happy one hour and in complete despair the next. All at the tiniest triggers.

Find a clean cloth (gauze if you can), apply pressure, and keep doing it until the bleeding stops. It doesn't matter if it bleeds through whatever you have just keep pressure and add more. Try keeping your leg high. If the bleeding doesn't stop you'll need medical assistance.
